meta.note: Two priced offers, each a complete self-contained Stage 1 engagement scoped to a stated final cost inclusive of GST. Stage 2 and the options are shown in both as indicative and NOT contracted, so nobody reads either ceiling as buying the migration.

fx.basis: USD/INR planning rate, September 2026 (spot band 94.6-95.8). Take a real quote at the day's rate.

licence.name: Claude Max 20x
licence.source: Tier price per aipricing.guru and IntuitionLabs, September 2026. NOTE: claude.com/pricing itself lists Max as 'From $100 per month' without separating the 5x and 20x tiers, so confirm at purchase.
licence.gst_note: Imported digital service (OIDAR). 18% IGST applies under reverse charge and is recoverable as input credit by a GST-registered supplier, so it is carried ex-tax in the cost base.

variants.label: Offer A
variants.headline: Remediate and inventory
variants.buys: The live site made lawful and measurable, and one authoritative register of what the estate actually contains. The redirect map is delivered by PATTERN with only the traffic-bearing tail decided by hand.
variants.not_buys: A row-by-row redirect map, a signed PDF disposition, orphan recovery, CSP hardening, the destination status-layer design, and the GIGW policy-page work. Each moves to Stage 2, where it will cost more than it would have here.

milestones.name: Mobilisation and inception report
milestones.exit: Team named. Inception report accepted: scope, RACI, access list, and the written re-statement of the objective as adopting DBIM and the Gov.In CMS Platform rather than moving to india.gov.in. Claude Max 20x provisioned to the named analyst.
milestones.evidence: Signed inception report; access requests lodged for the Joomla database, Search Console and registry.gov.in.

milestones.name: Live site remediated
milestones.exit: A missing path returns a genuine HTTP 404 under both a browser and a bare user agent. Header charset is UTF-8 and Devanagari renders. All 389 Hindi pages declare lang="hi". robots.txt published. joomla.xml no longer publicly readable.
milestones.evidence: Automated assertion suite run in front of the client, with before-and-after captures. Every item destination-independent, so none of it is wasted whichever target wins.

milestones.name: Platform and audit decision note
milestones.exit: Written intake position from the MoHFW CIO or a signed decision to take the DBIM-aligned rebuild. Audit route settled in writing. S3WaaS ruled in or out on the record. registry.gov.in control confirmed.
milestones.evidence: Decision note with one signed page per question, each with a named owner and a date.

milestones.name: Authoritative URL register
milestones.exit: One register unioning the Joomla database, a live two-signal crawl and Search Console traffic. Every URL appears exactly once, live-validated, with language tree, template and title. Triage dispositions captured for the traffic-bearing head of the estate.
milestones.evidence: Register delivered as a checked-in dataset with the crawl and validation code that produced it, so IPC can re-run it without the supplier.

milestones.name: Pattern redirect map and handover
milestones.exit: Redirect rules by URL pattern covering the estate, with the traffic-bearing tail decided row by row. Documented gap list naming every path still undecided, so Stage 2 starts from a known position rather than a fresh crawl.
milestones.evidence: Rule set plus a gap register. An automated check that every pattern resolves and no rule shadows another.

variants.label: Offer B
variants.headline: Remediate, inventory and decide
variants.buys: Everything in Offer A, plus a hand-decided redirect map covering every surviving path, a signed PDF disposition across ~2,758 documents, orphan recovery, CSP hardening, and the Stage 2 cost baseline as a contracted deliverable.
variants.not_buys: The migration itself. Stage 2 remains a separate procurement and its figure here is indicative until this engagement re-derives it.

milestones.name: Mobilisation and inception report
milestones.exit: Team named and on site. Inception report accepted: scope, RACI, access list, and the written re-statement of the objective as adopting DBIM and the Gov.In CMS Platform rather than 'moving to india.gov.in'.
milestones.evidence: Signed inception report; access requests lodged for the Joomla database, Search Console and registry.gov.in.

milestones.name: Live site remediated
milestones.exit: A missing path returns a genuine HTTP 404 under both a browser and a bare user agent. Header charset is UTF-8 and Devanagari renders. All 389 Hindi pages declare lang="hi". CSP no longer carries a wildcard with unsafe-inline and unsafe-eval. robots.txt published. joomla.xml no longer publicly readable.
milestones.evidence: Automated assertion suite, run in front of the client, with before-and-after captures. Every item destination-independent.

milestones.name: Platform decision pack
milestones.exit: Written intake position from the MoHFW CIO, or a signed decision to take the DBIM-aligned rebuild instead. Redirect capability and destination status-code behaviour proven and documented, with the origin status-layer design if needed. Audit route settled in writing. S3WaaS ruled in or out on the record. DBIM logo lockup determined. registry.gov.in control confirmed.
milestones.evidence: Decision pack with one signed page per question, each with a named owner and a date.

milestones.name: Draft inventory: the union register
milestones.exit: One register unioning the Joomla database, a live two-signal crawl, Wayback and Common Crawl orphans, and Search Console traffic. Every URL appears exactly once, live-validated, with language tree, template and title. Hindi paired by hreflang, never by URL transformation.
milestones.evidence: Register delivered as a checked-in dataset with the crawl and validation code that produced it, so the client can re-run it.

milestones.name: Signed disposition register and redirect map
milestones.exit: Every verified URL carries a keep / archive / retire disposition signed by a named IPC content owner, including explicit dispositions for PvPI, the news archive, the legacy paths and the PDF estate. Redirect map complete: one decided row per surviving source path, with Hindi rows byte-verified through the real toolchain.
milestones.evidence: Signed CSV. Automated check that every source path resolves to exactly one row and no destination is unreachable.

milestones.name: Stage 2 cost baseline and handover
milestones.exit: Stage 2 re-costed from the delivered register rather than from estimate, with quantities, rates and a three-point spread. Operating documentation and SOPs handed over. Recurring obligations listed with named owners.
milestones.evidence: Stage 2 baseline document plus the re-runnable model. This is the deliverable that makes Stage 2 procurable.
